source_registry.title: ISO/IEC 30141:2024 IoT reference architecture
source_registry.supports: Current IoT reference architecture; supports systems architecture as an explicit engineering concern.
source_registry.claim_limit: Public abstract does not prescribe specializations or roles.

source_registry.title: NIST SP 800-183 Networks of Things
source_registry.supports: IoT system model spans sensing, computing, communication, actuation and distributed system concerns.
source_registry.claim_limit: Technical model, not a curriculum or occupation taxonomy.

source_registry.title: NIST CPS Framework Vol. 1
source_registry.supports: CPS connects digital, physical and human components and includes realization and assurance concerns.
source_registry.claim_limit: Framework categories do not dictate a fixed specialization count.

source_registry.title: Arm Keil MDK guide
source_registry.supports: Illustrates microcontroller firmware and modular embedded software components.
source_registry.claim_limit: Vendor implementation guidance.

source_registry.title: ETSI MEC in IoT white paper
source_registry.supports: Describes device, edge, network and cloud placement; edge computing responds to latency, bandwidth and service requirements.
source_registry.claim_limit: Practitioner/standards-community paper, not neutral taxonomy or universal architecture.

source_registry.title: NISTIR 8259 Rev. 1 (2026)
source_registry.supports: Current manufacturer lifecycle activities for secure IoT product development and support.
source_registry.claim_limit: Recommended guidance; applicability depends on product/customer/risk profile.

source_registry.title: NISTIR 8259A/B capability catalog
source_registry.supports: Device identity/configuration, data protection, interface access, updates and state awareness; manufacturer documentation/support capabilities.
source_registry.claim_limit: Capability baseline is not a claim every device implements every feature.

source_registry.title: NIST SP 800-213 series
source_registry.supports: Connects organizational requirements to IoT device capabilities and profiles.
source_registry.claim_limit: Federal context and profiles must not be universalized.

source_registry.title: IETF RFC 7252 CoAP
source_registry.supports: Constrained application protocol for low-power/lossy networks and constrained nodes; one option alongside other protocols.
source_registry.claim_limit: Proposed Standard with updates/errata; protocol choice is use-case specific.

source_registry.title: oneM2M developer basics
source_registry.supports: Service layer sits between IoT applications and connectivity; common services include device management, registration and security.
source_registry.claim_limit: oneM2M architecture is one standards ecosystem, not a required stack.

source_registry.title: OPC UA core and companion specifications
source_registry.supports: Information models and services support industrial device/system interoperability, including IIoT.
source_registry.claim_limit: Industrial context and access/licensing of specifications vary.

source_registry.title: AWS IoT Greengrass architecture
source_registry.supports: Runs components locally, processes/filters data, supports MQTT and remote fleet management.
source_registry.claim_limit: AWS-specific architecture; components and cloud service are optional.

source_registry.title: AWS Greengrass component deployment and dependency resolution
source_registry.supports: Deployment targets device fleets and resolves platform/component version dependencies.
source_registry.claim_limit: Product documentation; not a general edge orchestration standard.

source_registry.title: Zephyr Project documentation
source_registry.supports: RTOS kernel, device drivers, board bring-up, application and production paths.
source_registry.claim_limit: Open-source project docs; supported targets and APIs are version-specific.

source_registry.title: Zephyr OTA / MCUboot guidance
source_registry.supports: Firmware updates use signed images and bootloader/partition processes; update security is a system design concern.
source_registry.claim_limit: One implementation path; product risk and hardware constrain update design.

source_registry.title: Thread overview
source_registry.supports: IPv6-based low-power mesh networking and device-to-device/cloud connectivity for home/building IoT.
source_registry.claim_limit: Thread focuses on a network technology; application layer and certification choices remain separate.

source_registry.title: Thread 1.4 features
source_registry.supports: Credential sharing, commissioning at scale, network diagnostics and infrastructure connectivity.
source_registry.claim_limit: Vendor/industry group claims; specific features depend on version and product certification.

source_registry.title: Thread Group Sub-GHz project (2026)
source_registry.supports: New work to extend IP mesh networking to Sub-GHz for industrial/commercial range needs.
source_registry.claim_limit: Work is underway, not a published specification or deployed capability guarantee.

source_registry.title: Arduino Cloud documentation
source_registry.supports: Device provisioning, dashboards, APIs, OTA and telemetry workflows for connected-device projects.
source_registry.claim_limit: Vendor platform example; not a universal IoT cloud stack.

source_registry.title: NIST IoT device definition FAQ
source_registry.supports: Device combines physical-world transducer capability with a network interface; may operate independently or depend on systems.
source_registry.claim_limit: NIST scoping definition, not a universal legal or academic definition.

source_registry.title: Zephyr Device Firmware Upgrade
source_registry.supports: Device Firmware Upgrade handles image and bootloader interactions; transport/management protocol remains a separate concern.
source_registry.claim_limit: Zephyr-specific implementation.

source_registry.title: Zephyr Trusted Firmware-M overview
source_registry.supports: Secure services include isolation, embedded cryptography, secret management, signed firmware verification and attestation.
source_registry.claim_limit: Platform support and security tradeoffs vary.

source_registry.title: Azure IoT Edge ML inference architecture
source_registry.supports: Model inference can run locally; model deployment/update design must account for offline devices, bandwidth and image size.
source_registry.claim_limit: Microsoft/Azure example; not a universal edge ML pattern.

source_registry.title: Azure IoT Edge GPU tutorial
source_registry.supports: GPU-backed inference is a concrete current deployment option on supported hardware/software.
source_registry.claim_limit: Specific Azure and GPU VM configuration; not a device baseline.

source_registry.title: NITDA National Centre for AI and Robotics
source_registry.supports: Official Nigerian R&D centre lists IoT, robotics, AI, digital fabrication and applied research as focus areas.
source_registry.claim_limit: Institutional remit is evidence of an R&D ecosystem, not job demand or national capacity.

source_registry.title: USPF Emerging Technologies Center
source_registry.supports: Public programme describes an Ogun State institute pilot and planned IoT, AI, edge-computing and training activities.
source_registry.claim_limit: Programme description/project scope; not proof that every listed capability is operational or a labor-market estimate.
